items.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022
items.q: the alto player in the band, Bobby Capers, leaned over to me... I think the three horn players, which were me, Bobby Capers on alto and Hubert Laws on tenor

ctx.x: Wow. Were your parents supportive of this solidifying of a career in music?

Not at all. Not at all. I was — after high school I was accepted to Columbia College, and they were looking for some kind of profession, preferably a lawyer, something like that. And after my first summer at Columbia, which was the summer of ’58, it was like an epiphany. I said boy this is what I’ve got to do. And when they heard that they were not very pleased at all. It took quite a while before they started to realize that it looks like he can make some money doing this. Because I have a vivid recollection of…
Thank you for that. That’s a terrific story. What was it like to, you must have been in the musician’s union eventually.
